full_judgment: 22. We also do not find any substance in the argument raised by BTCL on the point of limitation, as it appears to us that the petitioners misconstrued the time frame specified in schedule 2 Of the PPR, 2008, within which to raise any complaint under PPA, 2006 and PPR, 2008. A complainant must have reasonable grounds under Rule 56(ka) to file a formal complaint and schedule-2 of the PPR clearly states that the complaint should be filed within 7 days after becoming aware of such grounds. It appears that the BTCL approabats and reprobates in this case by taking recourse of aforesaid Rule 56 (Ka) in an attempt to make the complaint of NETAS time barred under PPR 2008 while their main argument is that the PPA 2006 and the PPR 2008 do not hernia any applicability in this matter.
